newsitem.title: MEXICO: Four jailed for murder of Mexican journalist.
newsitem.headline: Four jailed for murder of Mexican journalist.

text.p: A Mexican judge jailed four men on Friday on charges of murdering a journalist who took on drug traffickers in a remote town on the U.S. border, state news agency Notimex reported.
Benjamin Flores, 29, was gunned down in broad daylight last month outside the offices of La Prensa, the newspaper he edited in San Luis Rio Colorado, in northern Sonora state.
The judge jailed brothers Miguel Angel and Vidal Zamora for allegedly hiring Luis Enrique Rincon to shoot Flores. An alleged accomplice, Jorge Pacheco, was also jailed.
Flores founded La Prensa five years ago and denounced local drug barons and corrupt politicians from a hard-hitting column. Before his murder he had received death threats.
Police told Notimex they were still searching for two brothers of imprisoned drug lord Jaime Gonzalez Gutierrez, whom they suspect of masterminding the journalist's killing.
The four imprisoned suspects face sentences of 20 to 50 years in jail if found guilty.
